Only 23% of 4,441 remote listings reveal pay. Here’s what that means for your job search.

Our latest data shows 4,441 active remote jobs on Loker Dollar. Just 1,000 (23%) include a salary or hourly figure. The rest? 77% keep compensation private.

But here’s the twist: 2,753 listings (62%) are open to applicants anywhere in the world. That’s a huge opportunity for Indonesian talent seeking USD roles.

Top skills in demand? Communication (39%), AI (12%), Leadership (10%), Sales (8%), Project Management (7%), Data Analysis (7%). AI is growing fast—12% of listings now require it.

Companies like Neo Financial, TELUS Health, IDG, Hitachi, and Jobgether are hiring now. Only Neo Financial shows pay: $5 USD/hour for remote bilingual client services.

Contrarian take: lack of pay info doesn’t mean low wages—many firms expect negotiation. So don’t skip those roles.

Ready to find your remote USD job? Browse the live board and filter for “worldwide remote” to see 2,753 openings.
